newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Standard launches 12 offshore funds.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Standard launches 12 offshore funds.

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank said on Tuesday it had launched a range of 12 offshore funds designed to give South Africans an opportunity to invest in international markets.
The Standard Bank Offshore Unit Trusts -- comprising six equity, four currency and two bond funds -- were launched in conjunction with fund management group Fidelity Investments.

Standard said the funds were targeted at South Africans already holding assets offshore and those who would soon be allowed to export some of their capital under exchange control relaxations announced in last month's budget.
